sbi.name: State Bank of India
sbi.freeze_steps: Call the dedicated unauthorized transaction helpline. Use SBI YONO or official Internet Banking to block affected access or payment instruments.

hdfc.name: HDFC Bank
hdfc.freeze_steps: Contact HDFC Bank through its official phone banking or app and ask them to report the unauthorized transaction and block affected cards or access.

icici.name: ICICI Bank
icici.freeze_steps: Call ICICI Bank to report the unauthorized transaction. Use the official app or Internet Banking to block affected cards or access.

axis.name: Axis Bank
axis.freeze_steps: Contact Axis Bank through official fraud reporting or phone banking channels. Ask them to report the transaction and block affected cards or access.
